cluster_summary: Across these reasons, the model systematically over-applies a stock “false-belief task” script and a simple “label = contents” heuristic instead of tracking narrative updates. It repeatedly ignores that the focal character has directly inspected the container, now holds a true belief about the contents, and will project that belief to what another person will find, regardless of misleading tags. The errors also show recurring confusion about whose mental state is queried, answering from an uninformed observer’s perspective rather than the explicitly specified knowledgeable agent’s.

Thus the human answer D (coat) correctly tracks Xiao Li’s updated knowledge state, while the model’s choice B (carrot) is incorrect for mixing up label-based or other-agent belief with his own.
